verdict.rationale: Babylon.js exposes its entire functionality through a documented public JS/TS API (TypeDoc reference, NPM modular packages, full TypeScript typings/IntelliSense) that any script or AI agent can call directly to build/manipulate scenes — confirmed by live npm package (9.26.1) and doc.babylonjs.com/llms.txt probes. missing for 10: no formal machine-readable spec (OpenAPI/swagger endpoints all 404) and no independent report of an AI agent actually driving it programmatically beyond the docs.
